correctness.rationale: Exact affine dichotomy and normalization reduce all 4x4 ranks to real ranks of 3x3 incidence blocks. For each type an exhaustive finite polynomial-weighted enumeration of 64 or 512 projected triples is a proof for every dimension; all polynomial identities have cubic degree, with enough exact checked evaluations. Independent exhaustive raw 4x4 matrix ranks and determinants for d=3,4 and column set enumeration d=3,4,5 agree. Integer Cauchy–Binet moment and the earlier order-16 table agree. Limits: not arbitrary Hadamard orders or sizes.

value.rationale: A full singular-rank census of natural fourth-order Fourier sampling restrictions measures exact nullities of interpolation maps, not only a zero-minor total. The two affine row-set classes give all-dimensional closed counts and a new limiting rank distribution. This has direct structural significance for harmonic sampling in binary vector spaces.
